description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Flame Resolve Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Flame Resolve Mode
description.text: Casts Blade of Embers when another ally uses a Fire ability, removed after triggering four times, grants [Quadracast Spellblade 1] when removed
